We contacted Florian for our French Bulldog who was very unruly. In just four sessions, she stopped barking at home, she hardly reacts to other dogs anymore, and she no longer pulls on the leash!

Amazing results (reactive dog) from the very first session with Florian! A huge thank you to him, and I can't wait to continue the sessions to see our dog's progress. I highly recommend him!

Hiring Florian guarantees professional service. Besides being very friendly, he's a true expert in his field.
Florian adapts to both the owner and the dog. He's very reassuring and positive in his approach. And it works: my puppy has made great progress. I recommend him 100%!

Florian works intelligently and efficiently while respecting the animal.

We are very happy with Florian's effective work, attentiveness, and skills with our little Pomsky puppy. In just a few sessions, the results were visible on our dog. It's very valuable and important to be able to train him both indoors and outdoors. He's very adaptable and flexible; the whole family thanks you.

After just two sessions, my dog's (a Malinois mix) progress is amazing! Adopted from a shelter with a history of abuse, he was very aggressive towards humans. Now, we can already move around calmly in very stimulating environments; I'm starting to feel like myself again! Florian is competent, caring, and effective. Thank you!
My dog ​​was fearful of humans, but the problem was solved in less than an hour. I highly recommend this trainer. He's very professional.

I wholeheartedly recommend Florian! He's a passionate, attentive, and highly professional dog trainer. Thanks to his guidance, I've seen real progress with my dog, Victor. He takes the time to explain the exercises, adapts to both the dog and its owner, and always works with kindness. The sessions are enjoyable, effective, and build confidence. A huge thank you to Florian for his support; I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone who wants to better understand and train their four-legged companion!

I wholeheartedly recommend this dog trainer! Thanks to his professionalism, kindness, and invaluable advice, I've seen real progress in my dog. He takes the time to explain, adapts to each dog's personality, and is always attentive. The sessions take place in a wonderful atmosphere, and we always leave with practical tips to apply every day. Thank you for your support and passion. I'm so glad I trusted you and I won't hesitate to recommend you to everyone I know!

We would like to sincerely thank Florian for all his invaluable advice.

He shared his knowledge with us, his teaching skills, and his professionalism.

We highly recommend him and thank him from the bottom of our hearts.
Oly joins us in this sentiment.
Jo and Monique
DIBETTA.

I highly recommend Florian, who, in addition to being incredibly friendly, gave us excellent advice both indoors and outdoors with Beka (a Belgian Malinois/Australian Shepherd mix) who was barely 3 months old for her first lesson. I 100% recommend this dog trainer! My Belgian Malinois had a really hard time with other dogs; she would react as soon as she saw one. We only had two lessons with him, using professional and gentle methods, and the result is amazing. In two weeks, she hardly has any problems with other dogs anymore!

A huge thank you! You can tell he's patient and truly understands dogs. I highly recommend him if you have a difficult or reactive dog; it's definitely worth it.

By far the best trainer I've ever met!

He resolved the aggression and incompatibility between my dog ​​and my partner's dog, who couldn't live together anymore, in just one session...
Today they're the best of friends!!!

He's always available by text or call for invaluable advice.

Thank you a thousand times over, Florian, you saved our relationship and our family of four-legged children.

You can go to him with your eyes closed; whatever the problem, he'll be able to help you, without a doubt!

Marion, Maxime, Reyka, and Arya

Thank you, Florian. Two dogs who suddenly couldn't live together anymore, a family in a panic—you came along and in just one session you managed to give us the advice that, once applied, allowed us to live in an environment where everyone gets along.

Thank you a thousand times for your advice. You're truly passionate and manage to find the right arguments to help us, the owners, understand where we need to improve in training our dogs.

5/5! You can go with complete confidence.

We worked with Florian on our 10-year-old dog who was reactive to other dogs. Four sessions with him, combined with some work on our part, allowed our dog to go from walks on a leash and muzzle, during which we avoided all other dogs, to being able to walk him off-leash and without a muzzle without any reaction!
Florian did a fantastic job, his follow-up was excellent, and his sincerity and humanity were something we truly appreciated! A wonderful experience, thank you so much! 👌🏻
In just 5 lessons, our puppy learned all the basics and made great progress. Florian is a skilled teacher, attentive, and very effective. I highly recommend him!

And a platinum star to boot!
Florian is the Rolls Royce of dog training. Available and attentive, he has made life even better for my Nina and me than before.
Thank you for this magnificent teamwork. Go for it without hesitation, he's a gem.

I highly recommend Flo!

He's a super professional dog trainer, very friendly, and you can immediately tell he really understands canine psychology. His advice is clear, tailored, and easy to implement. Thanks to him, I understand my dog ​​much better, and he's made great progress. THANK YOU 🙏🏻
We called Florian in to help with our small, reactive, and fearful dog, Tonka. He intervened very effectively and now helps us train both of our dogs. Both dogs and owners are very satisfied.

Florian is the best trainer, I'm very satisfied. He's super friendly and gives great advice, especially for me, and my dog ​​adores him.

I can't wait to continue the sessions. Florian is a great listener, a skilled teacher, dedicated, and incredible. I highly recommend him.

We started training sessions for our 3-month-old American Shepherd. The approach is very precise and tailored, with a real understanding of the breed's specific needs. The support is thorough, focused, and personalized. Florian can be contacted even without a "problem dog," as was the case for us. I highly recommend him!

Florian is a fantastic dog trainer, very attentive to the issues. He's pleasant, a great teacher, and explains things clearly, which makes it easy to understand and apply the advice. I'm really happy with my dog's progress and development, as well as the activities we do at each session with Florian.

Florian is a remarkable dog trainer.

I contacted him when my dog, a 3-month-old puppy (Australian Shepherd/Husky mix), needed to learn all the basic commands.

From the very beginning, Florian was able to implement a clear, consistent, and kind training program, perfectly suited to such an intelligent and energetic puppy.

He doesn't just train the dog: he explains, guides, and teaches, which makes all the difference.

Thanks to his professionalism, patience, and passion, progress was rapid and lasting.
I wholeheartedly recommend Florian to anyone looking for a serious, compassionate, and truly competent dog trainer.

I called Florian about my 5-year-old Belgian Malinois who was too reactive around other dogs and almost impossible to take out in the park. In just 3 or 4 sessions, I feel much more confident and walks are finally enjoyable! Very friendly and attentive, I highly recommend him :)
I highly recommend Florian. He is very professional and resolved my dog's negative behaviors. He is always attentive and very competent. I thank him again.

I contacted Florian for my dog, who was reactive towards other dogs after she bit someone.
